source: Copied verbatim from jolt-relay spec/vectors/server-id.json (protocol v1, jolt-relay commit fb9c1b7) apart from this key. The relay repository is canonical: update them there first, then copy them here again.
description: serverId = 'srv_' + lowercase RFC 4648 base32 (no padding) of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256(raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key).
